lastText: ☰⚙File ClosedThe War That Waited, Still WaitingImperial General Headquarters, Beginning 1939The Cold War's opening arrives, and is declined. What's left is a resource empire that never earned recognition through victory, never lost it through defeat, and never asked for it on any terms but its own. Whether that holds, or is just a quieter version of the same deferred question, no one can yet say.The Theater Map at the end of the warPacific Situation · The war as it ended · Theater MapJapan: ContestedFormosa: ContestedManchukuo: ContestedNorth China: ContestedEast China: ContestedGuangdong: ContestedHunan-Guangxi: Allied-controlled / liberatedFree China: Allied-controlled / liberatedYan'an: Allied-controlled / liberatedTibet & Xinjiang: Neutral / not yet contestedIndochina: ContestedThailand: ContestedBurma: Allied-controlled / liberatedIndia: Allied-controlled / liberatedMalaya: ContestedSumatra: ContestedJava: ContestedBorneo: ContestedCelebes: ContestedMoluccas & Timor: ContestedLuzon: Allied-controlled / liberatedVisayas: Allied-controlled / liberatedMindanao: Allied-controlled / liberatedNew Guinea: Allied-controlled / liberatedSolomons: Allied-controlled / liberatedAustralia: Allied-controlled / liberatedGilberts: Allied-controlled / liberatedMarshalls: Allied-controlled / liberatedMarianas: Allied-controlled / liberatedPalau: ContestedJapanFormosaManchukuoNorth ChinaEast ChinaGuangdongHunan-GuangxiFree ChinaYan'anTibet & XinjiangIndochinaThailandBurmaIndiaMalayaSumatraJ
